title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.07725v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) is difficult to scale to small language models due to instability in long-horizon tool interactions and limited model capacity. While reinforcement learning methods like group relative policy optimization provide only sparse outcome-level rewards. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has gained popularity by supplying dense token-level supervision from a teacher on student-generated trajectories. However, our experiments indicate that applying OPD to TIR leads to a critical failure mode: erroneous tool calls tend to cascade across subsequent reasoning steps, progressively amplifying student-teacher divergence and rendering the teacher's token-level supervision increasingly unreliable. To address this, we propose SOD, a step-wise on-policy distillation framework for small language model agents, which adaptively reweights distillation strength at each step based on step-level divergence. translated_title: 小语言模型智能体的逐步在线策略蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07725v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：工具集成推理（TIR）由于长时程工具交互中的不稳定性和有限的模型容量，难以扩展到小语言模型。尽管像组相对策略优化这样的强化学习方法仅提供稀疏的结果级奖励。最近，在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过从教师模型在学生生成轨迹上提供密集的令牌级监督而受到欢迎。然而，我们的实验表明，将OPD应用于TIR会导致一个关键的失败模式：错误的工具调用往往会在后续推理步骤中级联，逐步放大学生与教师之间的分歧，并使教师的令牌级监督越来越不可靠。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SOD，一种用于小语言模型智能体的逐步在线策略蒸馏框架，该框架基于步骤级分歧自适应地重新加权每个步骤的蒸馏强度。
tldr: 提出SOD框架，通过逐步自适应调整蒸馏强度，解决了小语言模型在工具集成推理中因错误级联导致在线策略蒸馏失效的问题。
en_tdlr: The SOD framework adaptively reweights distillation strength at each step to address the failure of on-policy distillation in small language models caused by cascading tool-call errors in tool-integrated reasoning.
